eligibility: Applicants must be interested in open source projects
Applicants must be looking to gain real world experience coding on open source projects
Be eighteen (18) years of age or older upon registration.
Be eligible to work in the country in which they reside.
Not be an Organization Administrator or Mentor.
Be a student or a beginner to open source software development.
Not be a resident of a United States embargoed country.
Not be an employee, contractor, officer, or director of Google or its affiliates, or an Organization or any of its affiliates.
Not be an immediate family member of a Mentor or Organization Administrator.
Have not previously participated as a GSoC Student or GSoC Contributor two (2) or more times.
prepare: Discuss application ideas with mentoring organizations
Submit final work product and final evaluation
Accept the terms of the GSoC Contributor Agreement.
Submit a Project Proposal through the Program Website during the application period.
typical_timing: January 19: Mentoring organizations can begin submitting applications
February 3: Mentoring organization application deadline

February 19 - March 15: Potential GSoC contributors discuss application ideas with mentoring organizations
March 16: GSoC contributor application period begins
March 31: GSoC contributor application deadline
April 21: GSoC contributor proposal rankings due from Org Admins
April 30: Accepted GSoC contributor projects announced
May 1 - 24: Community Bonding Period
May 25: Coding officially begins!
July 6 - 18:00 UTC: Mentors and GSoC contributors can begin submitting midterm evaluations
July 10 - 18:00 UTC: Midterm evaluation deadline
July 6 - August 16: Work Period
August 17 - 24 - 18:00 UTC: Final week
August 24 - 31 - 18:00 UTC: Mentors submit final GSoC contributor evaluations
August 24 - November 2: GSoC contributors with extended timelines continue coding
November 2 - 18:00 UTC: Final date for all GSoC contributors to submit their final work product and final evaluation
November 9 - 18:00 UTC: Final date for mentors to submit evaluations for GSoC contributor projects with extended deadlines
